messages:
taylor_peopleops: Quick note on manager reassignments & appeals for this cycle — we added a lightweight reassignment flow and clarified the appeals steps. Details: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/reassign-appeal :point_up:
jose_manager: If my manager is OOO, can I reassign my directs to skip-level without approvals?
taylor_peopleops: You can provisionally reassign to skip-level for time-sensitive reviews but please file the reassignment form so People Ops can record it. Use /reassign-review @employee <new-manager> <reason>. That triggers an audit email.
kim_engineering: Does reassignment change calibration ownership? Who speaks for the person in the calibration meeting?
taylor_peopleops: The person who submitted the manager section (reassign submitter) should present in calibration. If the original manager returns and wants to add context, we accept supplemental notes before calibration cut-off.
vik_sre: After calibration, someone submitted an appeal. What's the routing & SLA?
taylor_peopleops: Appeal routing: 1) Manager triages first-touch with People Ops. 2) If unresolved, escalates to People Ops lead + org head. We target 7 business days. Please include the calibration notes and evidence when escalating.
jose_manager: Any template for appeals to standardize info?
taylor_peopleops: Yes — use the appeals template in the docs. Required fields: original rating, rationale, specific evidence, requested outcome, and any new info. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/appeal-template
peopleops_bot: Reminder: reassignment form v2 was published today. If you use the old link you'll get a 404.
taylor_peopleops: Quick manager checklist for reassignments & appeals:
```
- Confirm reassignment in form (/reassign-review)
- Add manager notes in People > Reviews > Notes
- Upload evidence (emails, PR reviews, OKR impact)
- If submitting appeal, attach calibration notes + template
- Notify skip-level/presenter and sign up for calibration slot
```
kim_engineering: Thanks 94 that checklist helps. Is there any change to deadlines when reassigned?
taylor_peopleops: Deadlines don't change unless you request an extension via /review-extend. If reassignment happens close to cutoff, flag People Ops so we can try to accommodate.
jose_manager: I'll reassign one direct and use the checklist. Thanks!
